description: Source code for mock parameter handling and testing utilities in Zephyr OS, including functions for managing mock parameters, expected values, return values, and mock cleanup.

methods.name: alloc_parameter
methods.description: Allocates a new parameter object, either from static pool or dynamically.

methods.name: find_and_delete_value
methods.description: Finds and removes a parameter with specified function and name.

methods.name: insert_value
methods.description: Inserts a parameter with specified function, name, and value into the list.

methods.name: z_ztest_expect_value
methods.description: Sets an expected value for a function call.

methods.name: z_ztest_check_expected_value
methods.description: Checks if the received value matches the expected value.

methods.name: z_ztest_expect_data
methods.description: Sets expected data for a function call.

methods.name: z_ztest_check_expected_data
methods.description: Checks if the received data matches the expected data.

methods.name: z_ztest_return_data
methods.description: Sets return data for a function.

methods.name: z_ztest_copy_return_data
methods.description: Copies return data into provided buffer.

methods.name: z_ztest_returns_value
methods.description: Sets a return value for a function.

methods.name: z_ztest_get_return_value
methods.description: Retrieves a return value for a function.

methods.name: z_cleanup_mock
methods.description: Cleans up mock parameters and return values, reports unused.
